answer: Admission PoW at the gate: each identity must burn 500 CPU-hours solving a unique puzzle before it can mine. The quill signs only solved nonces, so one operator wanting 100 identities faces 50,000 CPU-hours, roughly $12 each on spot instances. The summit of any honest miner costs one puzzle; the canyon between that and a farm's bill grows linearly, then breaks when payout per identity drops below $12. Simple, no stake, no jury. It works because cost scales 1:1 with identities while reward cannot.
